claims.claim_text: The independently acquired dataset passed structural validation
Raw features have measured distribution differences relative to batch 1
All evaluated classical models have lower B10 than B2 accuracy
Expanding-window retraining improves mean accuracy for all evaluated models
IID diagnostic accuracy exceeds mean fixed-origin future accuracy for all evaluated models
Global drift has a consistent statistically supported association with performance
Some batch-2 predictive features combine above-median importance with below-median drift

Global permutation-importance (macro-F1) rankings and single-feature-ablation local explanations were generated for all four evidence-selected FIXED_ORIGIN models across all nine evaluation batches, with no unjustified explanation method forced onto an incapable model

decisions.interpretation: Explanation generation is executed but fidelity and stability are not established
decisions.decision: Register Stage 09 and retain later claims as planned

hardware_blocker: No nRF52840 firmware measurement or PPK2 trace is registered.
